x-post /v/CallOfDuty. I know it's not surprising news given the pattern of CoD development, but it's good to have an official confirmation. An innovative call of Duty title.... Haven't seen one of those since CoD2.

I think Black Ops 3 did a good job of refining the jet-pack movement system that Advanced Warfare introduced without going overboard with the changes. Advanced Warfare used jet-packs as a quick lateral movement to dodge fire, which made the game annoying because as soon as you shot at someone they'd "jack rabbit" into the air and start raining bullets, oftentimes getting them the kill.

Black Ops 3 borrows more heavily from Titanfall's style of movement, where the jet-pack is a mobility tool instead of a dodging device, and it has too much of a "slow loft" to it to be useful for dodging. Black Ops 3 also did a better job with multi-elevation level design, so you felt like the level was made for wallrunning and climbing. Advanced Warfare felt like a traditional CoD level with jet-packs shoehorned in.

I wouldn't say it's a crazy level of innovation, but I think Treyarch did a good job of improving on the formula without going overboard or changing the core game like Advanced Warfare almost ended up doing.
